_note: Super League world (SPEC §17.2; T, 2026-10-27). Three tiers of 16, each a double round robin; 2 up and 2 down between tiers; nobody drops out of Blue. Every number is config. Dates are templates for season Y/Y+1, placed on the match slots as in Classic. No cups and no transfer windows: players move by trades, the draft and free agency (SL4-SL5 add their dates).
_financeNote: As Classic's (competitions_mvp.json). TV money scales by tier (SPEC §17.7; T, 2026-10-27): about EUR 200m, 119m and 81m a club, flatter than the tiers' revenue so relegation doesn't crush a club. Play-off prize money: per round won (the last is the final) and for the beaten finalist.
_boardNote: As Classic's. Targets judge the final table position: until the play-offs run (SL2), Star's 'Win the title' means finishing first in the table.
_playoffNote: A play-off, round by round (as Classic's): the table positions joining each round (entrants) or its fixed ties, how the round's clubs meet (reseed: best-placed against worst-placed; bracket: the previous round's ties in twos), its legs (two-legged: the better-placed club hosts the second leg) and whether it is at a neutral venue. allSingleLeg makes every round single-leg. Knockout rules as SPEC §8.6. Dates: the rounds take the slots after the last league round, midweek first, then alternating; the final is on the weekend nearest finalNear.

playoff._note: The title play-off (SPEC §17.2): the champion is its winner; the table winner is recorded but isn't a title.

softCap._note: The tiered soft cap (SPEC §17.7; figures T, 2026-10-27): Star's cap; Gold's is 80% of it, Blue's 65%, so Blue's median club spends about half its revenue on wages, as Classic's target. Opening payrolls are 85-100% of the club's cap.
softCap._rulesNote: Over the cap a club may re-sign its own players, sign its draft picks, sign free agents only at minimumWage, and trade if the wages it takes back are at most tradeMatching x those it sends out. Luxury tax: luxuryTaxRate x the payroll above the cap at season end, shared equally among the tier's clubs under the cap. A relegated club keeps its old tier's cap for graceSeasons. AI re-signings price wages and budget as if the club's revenue were its cap / aiWageRatio, the wage ratio the cap was set for (T, 2026-10-27), so payrolls stay near the cap.

draft._note: The draft (SPEC §17.5). SL2 builds its AI core: no lottery draw yet (the pool picks in odds order) and the AI makes the user's picks too, until SL4. Order, the same each round: the lottery pool, best odds first (the 4 worst Blue clubs, then the 4 relegated); then the other clubs in reverse combined standings (Blue, Gold, Star, each from the bottom of its table); the 4 promoted clubs last, by the same rule. Prospect quality: mean + perYear x (age - youngest) + noise, clamped. AI picks: OVR and POT (potWeight on POT), plus needBonus per player the club is short of areaTargets in the prospect's area. Rookie wages by pick, interpolated. First values, tuned in SL4 and SL6.

renewals._note: One re-signing period from the draft to 30 June (SPEC §17.6, SL5); no renewals during the season.

keyDates._offseasonNote: After promotion and relegation (1 June): the draft lottery, the draft, then the re-signing period to 30 June (SPEC §17.2, §17.6). Stages without content until SL4 (draft) and SL5 (re-signing).

rosterRules._note: No academies in this world (SPEC §17.4): the academy fields are unused. The 25 counts from the first league match (SL5).
